components.name: Social Navigation Link
components.description: Amber Instagram link presented as the sole navigation pill.

components.name: Gallery Card
components.description: Photographic live-performance tile with brown caption overlay and lightbox behavior.
components.css: .gallery-card { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: #faf3e6; border: 1px solid rgba(44,24,16,.08); border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(44,24,16,.08); } .gallery-card::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 35%, rgba(44,24,16,.52)); }

narrative.overview: The current interface is a sun-warmed, print-inspired music identity built from parchment surfaces, dark brown ink, amber highlights, and real live photography. Rye, Crimson Pro, and Stint Ultra Expanded create a hand-lettered Americana voice with an editorial reading layer and compact show-card metadata.
keyCharacteristics: Amber used as a scarce interaction signal
Real people, venues, photographs, and video lead

rules.name: The Amber Signal Rule
rules.body: Use amber for orientation, interaction, dates, and small emphasis rather than filling every surface.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Rye for identity and names, Crimson Pro for reading, and Stint Ultra Expanded for compact metadata.

rules.name: The Paper-First Rule
rules.body: Use parchment layers and borders before adding a shadow; depth should feel ambient and tactile.

dos: Do preserve the parchment, deep brown, and amber relationship.
Do use real band photography and factual event information.
Do honor the 768px and 480px responsive behavior.
donts: Don't replace the identity with a generic white, neon, or dark-mode system without explicit redesign intent.
Don't turn every action into a rounded pill.
Don't fabricate event details, testimonials, clients, metrics, or booking claims.
